proofs.text: Write a retired scope tag naming a Windows runner into a spec of the v0.9.5 fixture, apply, and verify it reads `@env(windows)` with the retired tag gone; decline the rewrite and verify both the retired tag and `@env(` are gone and the output says it would rather not guess. Verify the fixture's own retired tier tag becomes one `PROOF-53` line ending `@unit @env(windows)`. Verify a scope naming no operating system is dropped with that reason printed, and that a placeholder in prose is still there after the run

rule_text: A proof's retired operating-system tag becomes `@env(<os>)` when the person confirms the system it names, is dropped when they decline or when it names no operating system, and the retired tier tag becomes `@unit @env(windows)`; text that only looks like a tag is left alone

def test_a_confirmed_scope_becomes_env(tmp_path):
    root = _with_scopes(tmp_path)
    rel = 'specs/core/locking.md'
    assert SCOPE in _read(root, rel)
    _apply(root)
    text = _read(root, rel)
    assert '@env(windows)' in text
    assert SCOPE not in text
tests.name: test_a_confirmed_scope_becomes_env

def test_a_declined_scope_drops_the_tag(tmp_path, capsys, monkeypatch):
    root = _with_scopes(tmp_path)
    rel = 'specs/core/locking.md'
    _answers(monkeypatch, [('Rewrite the windows-2022 scope', 'n')])
    _apply(root, argv=())
    printed = capsys.readouterr().out
    text = _read(root, rel)
    assert SCOPE not in text
    assert '@env(' not in text
    assert 'rather than guess an operating system' in printed
tests.name: test_a_declined_scope_drops_the_tag

def test_prose_that_is_not_a_tag_is_left_alone(tmp_path):
    root = _with_scopes(tmp_path)
    rel = 'specs/core/runners.md'
    before = _read(root, rel)
    assert '%s<' % SCOPE in before       # a placeholder, not a real scope
    _apply(root)
    assert '%s<' % SCOPE in _read(root, rel)

def test_the_retired_tier_tag_becomes_unit_and_env(tmp_path):
    root = _project(tmp_path, V095)
    rel = _spec_holding(root, 'msvcrt.locking')
    assert '@windows\n' in _read(root, rel)
    _apply(root)
    text = _read(root, rel)
    proofs = [line for line in text.splitlines()
              if line.startswith('- PROOF-53 ')]
    assert len(proofs) == 1
    assert proofs[0].endswith('@unit @env(windows)')
    assert '@windows\n' not in text
tests.name: test_the_retired_tier_tag_becomes_unit_and_env
